defect.mechanism: the governed-use coverage check ran only when scope.get('target_use_refs') was non-null, so an ABSENT key was never judged and a positive snapshot with no governed-use coverage resolved POSITIVE

reproduced_before_any_change.fixture: the court's own _aref factory, positive authority material identical to the lawful case except target_use_refs removed from ONE snapshot
reproduced_before_any_change.impact_confirmed: both TEMPORAL_COMPARABILITY and TARGET_USE_PERMISSION could resolve positive without proving the governed use is covered

repair.rule: a use-scoped authority must carry EXPLICIT governed-use coverage for the exact complete target-use ExactRef(s) the operation requires; ABSENCE of target_use_refs fails closed
repair.single_site: resolve_required_authority, which is the shared resolver behind every F7 authority path that declares use scope required, so one change covers both named paths
repair.no_wildcard_inference: an omission is never read as unrestricted. An EXPLICIT unrestricted marker IS still honoured, because that is a positive, deliberately authored representation recognised by _scope_covers_governed_use -- a different thing from omitting the key. This satisfies the commission's clause permitting an explicit unrestricted representation to be recognised, while refusing silence
repair.exact_ref_identity_preserved: RR-02's complete-ExactRef comparison is untouched; the new check runs BEFORE it and cannot weaken it

discriminating_witnesses: test_hq219_rr02b_only_an_explicit_covering_grant_authorizes[4 cases: explicit unrestricted, absent, different exact use, bare object_id]

targeted_break.method: the same authority, kind and governed use, differing ONLY by whether target_use_refs is present, must land on OPPOSITE outcomes
targeted_break.proves: if the fail-closed branch were removed both sides would be positive and this witness would fail, so a green run cannot be an artefact of a check that never discriminates
targeted_break.verified_to_reopen_the_gap: an earlier monkeypatch-based version of this break did NOT reopen the gap, because the absence branch runs before the coverage helper; it was rewritten to the presence/absence discrimination above, which does

sustained_invariants_untouched: RR-02 complete ExactRef comparison where use scope is present
resolution of every supplied target-use permission ref
no_new_ontology: no relation state, authority kind, relation kind, source ontology or actor semantics was added
